g.text: Floor -2.10 m. Nominal clear height 2.12 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
Freight arrives through the port baggage lock. The long starboard service passage connects both lifts to engineering, so
a steward can cross the ship without threading through cases or a passenger salon.
